== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid (Japanese)|WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67771 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(50, 16, 430, 612)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>1040b94d39c4d01e938500181c474b60fa2e401c02b7e78114968f55a25c3b55</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
